description: Source code for the AudioRendererPassthrough class, implementing audio passthrough functionality for Android, including handling of audio decoding, buffer management, and synchronization with AudioTrack.

classes.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
classes.description: Class implementing audio passthrough rendering with buffer management, thread handling, and synchronization for Android.

methods.name: ParseAc3SyncframeAudioSampleCount
methods.description: Parses AC-3 syncframe to determine the number of audio samples.

methods.name: AudioRendererPassthrough
methods.description: Constructor initializing the audio renderer with stream info and DRM system.

methods.name: ~AudioRendererPassthrough
methods.description: Destructor, resets states and seeks to zero if valid.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the renderer with error, prerolled, and ended callbacks.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Decodes and writes input audio buffers.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Handles end of stream signaling.

methods.name: SetVolume
methods.description: Sets the playback volume.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamWritten
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been written.

methods.name: IsEndOfStreamPlayed
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been played.

methods.name: CanAcceptMoreData
methods.description: Indicates if more data can be accepted.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified media time.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Returns current media playback time and status info.

methods.name: CreateAudioTrackAndStartProcessing
methods.description: Creates and starts the audio track processing thread.

methods.name: FlushAudioTrackAndStopProcessing
methods.description: Flushes and stops audio track processing for seeking.

methods.name: UpdateStatusAndWriteData
methods.description: Updates audio track status and writes audio data.

methods.name: OnDecoderConsumed
methods.description: Callback when decoder consumes data, signals readiness for more input.

methods.name: OnDecoderOutput
methods.description: Handles output from decoder, queues decoded audio.
